title: Typewriter and Letter
author: Isandro Fairweather
blurb: Ivo Ashgrove, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, has spent three years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the century turns.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
